topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The earth turned easily under my paws, a familiar rhythm as I unearthed the cache. The scent was not of my kin, not of recent prey, but it held a different kind of allure, an older, more subtle whisper. I had not made this, yet it spoke to me, a challenge accepted long ago but just now remembered. The object, foreign and yet not, held secrets bound in earth and time. I sat back, my breath steady, and let the forest watch. This was not merely a find; it was a revelation, a testament to the layers of life and mystery that unfold here, always, within my reach.
